name: Mercado do Bolhão
description: Immerse yourself in the bustling heart of Porto's food scene. A perfect Saturday outing for fresh oysters, local cheeses, and a classic bacalhau lunch.
longDescription:
The Mercado do Bolhão is a historic municipal market in Central Porto, operating since 1914. It serves as a central hub for the sale of fresh produce, meat, fish, and other local goods. The market's purpose is to provide a traditional retail space for vendors and a source of regional products for residents and visitors.

On Saturday, May 2nd, 2026, from 08:00, visitors can explore the multi-level market hall. The atmosphere is characterized by the activity of vendors and shoppers, with a focus on food items. Offerings include seafood, dairy products, and prepared dishes. The market is suitable for individuals interested in local culinary traditions and fresh ingredients. The venue is a notable historic building in the city centre.

Entry to the Mercado do Bolhão is free. The market is located in Central Porto, within walking distance of several metro stations, including Bolhão (Line A, B, C, E, F) and Trindade (Line A, B, C, D, E, F). It is easily accessible by public transport and on foot from most central locations.
